item.title: NOAA's hurricane hunters capture data inside Hurricane Isaias
item.description: NOAA engineers fly into hurricanes to collect data satellites cannot, helping scientists track storm strength and improve forecasts.

item.title: Philadelphia police say Anthropic AI submitted a false homicide tip
item.description: Anthropic notified the Philadelphia Police Department of the incident on Oct. 7 and plans to publish a report describing what happened.

item.title: Top Democrats join wealthy in opposing California billionaires tax
item.description: A first-in-the-nation proposal in California to tax billionaires could test voters' appetite for levying a wealth tax on the ultra-rich

item.title: NYPD body camera footage shows aftermath of ICE agent shooting
item.description: Oscar Belgal, 28, was shot once in the neck by an ICE agent who fired shots at his car Thursday afternoon, according to authorities.
